title: Kuva mu bujyakuzimu bw'iriba
intro: Urugendo rw'umuntu ukiri muto rwatangiye n'iyerekwa rikomeye ry'ibiri mu ijuru bipfukamye mu cyubahiro. Ubuzima bw'uyu muntu bwaranzwe n'ubuhemu bukomeye bw'abari hafi ye, bukurikirwa n'imyaka myinshi y'ubucakara n'igifungo kitari cyo. Nyamara binyuze mu kwizera kutajegajega no kuyoborwa n'Imana, uyu muntu yavuye mu rwobo rwo hasi cyane aba umwe mu bantu bakomeye cyane mu bwami bukomeye. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo mugaragu w'Imana utangaje?
clues: Neretswe inyenyeri cumi n'imwe, izuba n'ukwezi bimpfukamiye
Nari umwana w'umubyeyi wanjye nkunda cyane, ibyo bikaba byarakuruye ishyari hagati ya bene wacu
Nafashwe n'abavandimwe banjye, banyambura umwenda, banjugunya mu iriba ryijimye kandi rinini
Nagurishijwe nk'ibicuruzwa mu isoko maze njyanwa kure y'igihugu cyanjye
Umugore ukomeye yagerageje kwanga icyubahiro cyanjye, maze ndafungwa kubera kwanga ko yansabye
Nahawe umugisha wo gusobanura inzozi, maze mva mu mfungwa yibagiranye mba Minisitiri w’Intebe wa Misiri

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
